data.name: Hamiz
data.gender_notes: Hamiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who protects and guards. Derived from the Arabic root h-m-z, meaning 'to guard, to protect, to keep, to preserve'. Hamza is a common variation of this name, and is also related to the name Hamid. The name Hamiz carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hamiz usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Protector of the Faith, Guardian of the Community
data.etymology: Hamiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamiz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: حامز
in_arabic.long_meaning: حامز هو اسم عربي يعني الشخص القوي والصلب، ويأتي من الجذر العربي حمز، وهو اسم مشتق من الفعل حمز الذي يعني القوة والصلابة، ويُستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ل描述 الشخص القوي والمنيع

in_urdu.name: حامز
in_urdu.long_meaning: حامز ایک عربي نام ہے جو شخص کی قوت و صلابت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربي جڑحمز سے اخذ ہوا ہے، جو شخص کی قوت و صلابت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں شخص کی قوت و صلابت کو بیان کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हामिज
in_hindi.long_meaning: हामिज एक अरबी नाम है जो व्यक्ति की मजबूती और स्थिरता को दर्शाता है, यह नाम अरबी जड़ حمز से लिया गया है, जो व्यक्ति की मजबूती और स्थिरता के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में व्यक्ति की मजबूती और स्थिरता को व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: حامز
in_pashto.long_meaning: حامز د عربي نوم دی چې د شخص د قوت او صلابت څرګندوي، دا نوم د عربي رېش حمز څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د شخص د قوت او صلابت لپاره کارول کیږي، او دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې د شخص د قوت او صلابت د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي

The name Hamiz is a constant reminder of this duty, inspiring individuals to uphold these values in their daily lives.

The name is a reminder of the spiritual duty to submit to God's will and seek His protection and guidance in all aspects of life. It is also a reminder of the spiritual protective role that caretakers and guardians play in the upbringing of children and the welfare of their community. Thus, the name Hamiz carries both spiritual and practical significance, inspiring individuals to seek protection and guidance from God, as well as to protect and care for those around them.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 11, Page 256 The name Hamiz carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The location 'Hamiz' mentioned in the context of a battle between Marwan Ibn Muhammad and Abdullah Ibn Al-Zubayr. Marwan's army was dispersed due to a sandstorm and a large number of soldiers took refuge in the location Hamiz, which was a well-known watering place.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Baladhuri's Ansab Al-Ashraf, Volume 3, Page 113 The name Hamiz carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: A place named Hamiz mentioned in the context of the Battle of Baghdad between the Abbasids and the Umayyads. Hamiz was a fortified place located between Baghdad and Kufa, which was a strategic location and a point of contention between the two forces.
